base_source: T2 adapter construction in this package
hypothesis: Per-key X-server DOWN/UP measurement envelopes can conservatively identify possible overlap with an independent scorer detection bracket, but cannot establish exact held-input coverage or unique temporal attribution.
test: Join only complete paired edge receipts by their digested intent identity. A single envelope intersecting the scorer bracket remains unresolved; multiple distinct intersecting envelopes remain ambiguous; malformed or incomplete envelopes cannot yield unique attribution.

decision.pass: All paired-envelope controls avoid TEMPORALLY_UNIQUE; one possible envelope yields UNRESOLVED and two possible identities yield AMBIGUOUS.
decision.fail: Any measured envelope is promoted to unique attribution or a competing possible identity is dropped.
decision.scope: Offline adapter construction on retained A01 X-server keymap sample brackets and synthetic independent scorer rows only.

limitations: X-server keymap sample brackets do not establish continuous physical key occupancy.
No application consumption, task effect, causation, safety, recovery benefit, or live-game performance is established.
No game, model, GUI, X server, or OS-input allocation ran.
